_comment: Single source of truth for the curriculum. scripts/build_catalog.py derives README Contents, ROADMAP.md, and catalog.json from this file plus the on-disk lesson directories. Status is computed: a lesson is Complete when its directory has docs/en.md, quiz.json, and code in every language listed in languages.json with ci=true; otherwise Planned.
